description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. No 11 of 2021 " SATGURU TRAVEL AND TOURISM LLC "
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a legal order under Section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It specifies regulatory designations, exemptions, and incentives for a business entity under existing legislation. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers, not detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel announcements.
